title: Ning Li and Podkletnov rotating superconductors

tellings.quote: But then you got Ming Le's work with the rotating superconductor of IBCO. Also, Eugene Pleutnov used rotating superconductors

plain: Two scientists spun superconductors, materials that carry electricity with no resistance when very cold: a physicist named Ning Li worked with a rotating disc of a ceramic superconductor called YBCO, and a scientist named Eugene Podkletnov also used rotating superconductors. Michels names this work himself, without naming a source, in a talk with a Navy scientist about patents for unusual craft, as earlier examples of experiments along the same lines.
